items.preText:
7pm Hope and Jewel Andrew at the crease. Mayank Yadav will start proceedings with his speedy rockets. One slip in place. Arquam: "Where are Ekanth JP and KK from your comm team? Been long since heard from them?" -- They've been in action, but maybe you've just missed them! Ekanth had his fun recently calling the Durban Test. Chan: "This team looks to have a feeling of settled side. Prince Yadav looks to be an great addition , so is Naman Dhir. "

Phani Chilamkur: "Will the cricketing janata accept my gut feeling - that this will not be a high scoring match??" -- Brave prediction, let's see if you're proven right!

Arquam: "How unlikely is Hardik Pandya to play SL ODI series on a scale of you posting 8 user comments in one (unobstructed) Jadeja over?" -- I am barely able to post a single user comment in a Ravindra Jadeja over! But fans will hope Hardik is back for that series. 6.47pm Hemant Brar reports that until a few minutes ago, Arshdeep Singh was bowling at the adjacent strip. He was targeting the yorker length and getting the ball to curve in prodigiously. Let's see if, and how early, he bowls the same length in the match. 6.45pm It's a 64, square boundary on one side and 67m on the other. 75m boundary down the ground. It's a mixed soil pitch. Murali Karthik says the pitch is 80% red soil and 20% black, although Shreyas Iyer quoted a 75-25 mix. Murali Karthik says there are too many cracks on the pitch and says the pitch has an "interesting texture." There shouldn't be dew, according to the curator.

Mustafa Moudi : "Abhishek Sharma, Ishan Kishan and Nitish Kumar Reddy in Hyderabad... SUN is going to RISE in the Evening !!"

What unique record did Marnus Labuschagne achieve in the Durban Test. That and five other questions are waiting for you in today's KNOW YOUR CRICKET. 6.30pm It's toss time. Shai Hope out there for West Indies, and for India, it's Shreyas Iyer, who has just made the move up to No. 4 on the ICC men's T20I batting charts. Hope calls it wrong. India will bowl first. Iyer says India want to have a look at the relaid surface and bat after getting a better idea. India are unchanged. Jewel Andrew replaces Kamil Pooran and Romario Shepherd is back for Quentin Sampson.

India: 1 Abhishek Sharma, 2 Sanju Samson (wk), 3 Ishan Kishan, 4 Shreyas Iyer (capt), 5 Tilak Varma, 6 Naman Dhir, 7 Nitish Kumar Reddy, 8 Axar Patel, 9 Prince Yadav, 10 Mayank Yadav, 11 Arshdeep Singh

West Indies: 1 Shai Hope (capt, wk), 2 Jewel Andrew, 3 Shimron Hetmyer, 4 Rovman Powell, 5 Sherfane Rutherford, 6 Romario Shepherd, 7 Roston Chase, 8 Shamar Springer, 9 Keemo Paul, 10 Shamar Joseph, 11 Gudakesh Motie 6.20pm Tilak Varma's preferred position is No. 3. It's a role he's excelled in. But with India's excess of top-order batting talent, he's now been shuttled down to the middle order, but he's enjoying that role as well.

Nicholas: "Runs galore right ?" Should be! 6.10pm The Abhishek-Chase battle. Kuldeep's spot in the XI. The pitch. Of course the pitch. These pertinent topics, and everything else important and interesting about this contest have all been covered by Sid Monga in his preview.

It's Gautam Gambhir's birthday today, but he isn't the solution to WORD PLAY. Find the seven-letter word as fast as you can. 6.05pm Given Hardik Pandya's fitness issues, Nitish Kumar Reddy is a key player in the lead-up to next year's World Cup, but is he getting the opportunities he needs to grow into his role asks Hemant Brar. 6pm Hello and welcome, everyone. Today, the India-West Indies six-hitting contest T20I series moves to Hyderabad, with India ahead 2-1. Will Hyderabad be just another batting paradise, and can West Indies fight back to stay alive in the series? Stay tuned to find out on Cricinfo's live coverage of this game with me - Abhimanyu - and my co-commentator for the day, Abhijato Sensarma. If you're waiting for this match to start, why don't you head over to CRICINFO GAMES and play our daily puzzles. Test your cricket knowledge and see how much you can score!
items.text: Starts off with a 145kph length delivery outside off that seams in from outside off, Hope tucks it fine on the leg side for a single
144kph length ball around off, Andrew pats it down to midwicket
On a length on off, Andrew blocks

Hurries him with a bouncer! 144kph back-of-length delivery climbs on Andrew, who somehow manages to miscue a pull behind square. The throw at the on-striker's end deflects off the stumps, allowing an extra run
On a length outside off, 146kph, punched to point
Andrew now comes down the track as Mayank goes short and wide. He has a swipe at it but can't connect

items.preText: Arshdeep from the other end. Around the wicket
items.text: Length ball angled in from outside off, Hope eases it towards mid-o for a single
Oh, he gets a hold of that, the youngster! Full ball on middle and leg, angled across, and Andrew clears his front leg and hoicks it over midwicket
Great comeback from Arshdeep! Nails the yorker outside off and it sneaks under Andrew's bat
items.shortText: Arshdeep Singh to Andrew, no run

items.preText: Shashank: "Why do the West Indies keep changing their opening pair every match?" -- Well, Hope and Kamil Pooran opened in all three T20Is before this on this tour
items.text: Another boundary!. Comes down the track to this length ball on leg and flat-bats it straight of mid-on
Slices it over the infield! Full outside off and Andrew looks to go inside out. Ends up slicing it over point. The fielders give chase and are able to save a couple of runs
Punched past mid-off! Low full toss outside off, drilled down the ground, giving the fielder no chance
That's gone over everyone! 142kph bouncer on off and it sails over Hope and the leaping Samson
Another bumper on off, and Samson just about manages to collect. Second bouncer of the over and it's a no ball. Free hit coming up!
Dispatched! Clears his front leg to this length ball as Mayank tries to go pace-off, and heaves it away over midwicket
Off the pads and it trickles away for four! Full ball angled across, Hope misses as he tries to glance it fine, but the deflection of the pads gets the job done anyway
141kph, short and wide, Hope dances down and moves leg-side and has a swipe but the ball goes over the top edge
Full around off, clipped out to deep midwicket
Length ball outside off, cranked up to 147kph, Andrew manages to swing it away through midwicket for a couple of runs
Another extra! Back of length delivery on off angled across, Andrew tries to swing it away but it goes down leg side
How's that not hit anything?! Length ball outside off seams in further. Andrew skips down and tries to swing it away but is beaten on the inside edge and the ball just goes over the leg bail
items.postText: After the Durban Test, Andrew McGlashan writes about Josh Hazlewood's enduring genius.

items.text: Full outside off, Hope hits a nice drive but straight to extra cover
items.shortText: Prince Yadav to Hope, no run

items.text: Glorious! Handsome lofted drive! This is right in the slot on off and Hope clears his front foot and chips it down the ground with a vertical bat
Very full outside off, but Hope meets it with an open face to drill it away through cover point!
On a length on off, clipped out to deep midwicket
